verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence touching data sent back to the vendor is the Diagnostics CLI: its troubleshooting data is not transmitted to New Relic by default, and uploading is optional. Community posts add product-level switches (agent env vars, a Data Management Hub setting) to turn off default log collection, but that is customer telemetry ingestion rather than vendor usage tracking, so it supports the story only weakly. missing for 10: a documented opt-out of product usage/analytics tracking across the CLI, agents and UI, coverage of the newrelic-cli and MCP server, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: By default, this data is not transmitted to New Relic. You do have the option to upload this information to your New Relic account over HTTPS.
setting the env vars NEW_RELIC_APPLICATION_LOGGING_ENABLED=false and NEW_RELIC_APPLICATION_LOGGING_FORWARDING_ENABLED=false disables the new default log collection
On a free account, you can disable automatic log collection in the Data Management Hub under 'log settings'.
